ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $4M scheme involving a St. Paul business owner.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: I believe that investigating Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could lead to a larger story about the need for increased oversight and accountability in the Medicaid program. By analyzing data and conducting interviews with experts, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and potential solutions.
